body:
Closes #2234. This fully delivers it: the finding D14-s3-02 and all six sweep
instances the issue lists (energy, supply, return, flow, humidity, and power and
mode beyond the finding) are closed in this diff (`## Figures`, instance probe
and class enumerator). The class's RCA, `dev/audit/rca/R10-N-staleness.md`,
gets its countermeasure here as the declaration check, in a form that departs
from the one the RCA proposed (below).

A source that reports only on change writes nothing while its value holds, so
its age measures how still the value is, not whether the source is alive.
`InputReader` held every source to `const.INPUT_MAX_AGE_MINUTES`, a polling
limit, so an idle power meter at 0 W read stale on 39 of 48 replay cycles and
an unchanged mode select on 47 (D14-s3-02). The R10 sweep
(`dev/audit/rounds/round10/sweep-N-staleness.md`) found five more instances:
energy, supply, return, flow meter and the coordinator's humidity limit.

The fix is one freshness rule keyed on how the source reports, as the
architect note asks:

- `inputs.source_polls(owner, entity_id, state)` is True once the entity has
  been seen re-reporting an unchanged value (`last_reported` past
  `last_updated`, which Home Assistant only writes for a repeat; the manifest
  floor is 2025.2, so `last_reported` always exists). `hass` remembers it in a
  `WeakKeyDictionary` side table (boost.py's precedent). A polling source whose
  last write was a change therefore keeps its polling limit.
- `inputs.age_limit_for` picks `INPUT_MAX_AGE_MINUTES` for a polling source and
  `const.INPUT_ON_CHANGE_MAX_AGE_MINUTES` for any other. `InputReader._begin`
  calls it whenever the caller did not pass its own limit. An explicit limit
  and `UNBOUNDED` behave as before.
- `INPUT_ON_CHANGE_MAX_AGE_MINUTES` copies the polling table and overrides the
  keys whose value can hold indefinitely: power, energy, mode, supply, return
  and flow get `inf` (no age limit; `unavailable` still refuses). Indoor
  humidity gets the room's quiet-store bound of 360 min, because it is the room
  probe's own channel. `max_age_for` maps `inf` to `None`, so diagnostics and
  the card show "no limit" rather than a huge number.
- Humidity moves into the tables (polling limit 120, unchanged) and
  `_indoor_humidity_value` reads through `InputReader`. This deletes the
  coordinator's own state lookup, age check, float parse and finiteness test,
  along with `coordinator.HUMIDITY_MAX_AGE_MINUTES`.
- Every other key keeps its polling limit as its on-change limit. Those keys
  are the quiet stores (R9's 6 h bound), outdoor and house power (they move
  within their bound), the fail-safe signals (pump signals, wood-side probes,
  flue, solar) and PV (no reader applies it; class P6).
  `tests/features.py`'s `_r10st_same` names each of them with its reason. The
  check refuses an undeclared key, an equal key left unnamed, and a named key
  that is not equal. This departs from the countermeasure that
  `dev/audit/rca/R10-N-staleness.md` (at d23205d13) proposed. The RCA proposed
  a numeric quiet-interval table beside the limit and a check refusing a limit
  below it. The shipped check instead forces a per-key on-change decision.
  The 7 overridden keys carry a number the check compares. For the 19 keys
  kept equal (26 - 7), the decision rests on a reason string in
  `_r10st_same`, and no quiet number is compared. The RCA's non-vacuity clause
  is not covered either: it counts the module `*_MAX_AGE_MINUTES` constants
  (DHW inlet, MODE_LAST_GOOD) beside the table. The detector is demonstrated
  by the #2683 r1 review's plants: a planted undeclared key fails 1 check, and
  the power limit set back to 30.0 fails 3.

Alternatives rejected:

- (a) Raising the polling limits to the quiet interval. That blinds the dead
  polling sensor the watchdog exists for, and the null control says that
  bound must hold.
- (b) A per-key quiet table with no reporting-kind test. It still declares a
  quiet idle power meter dead at whatever finite number it picks.
- (c) Judging the kind from the current state alone, without memory. That
  fails open on a dead polled meter whose last write was a change. The census
  arm "remembered past a changing write" pins it.

The carry's comment fix also lands: the `_RANGE_KEYS` comment in `inputs.py`
no longer names `ATTR_MIN_TEMP`/`ATTR_MAX_TEMP`.

Behaviour change, stated: an on-change source of an `inf` key that dies
without going `unavailable` is never aged out. That is the brief's rule ("stale
only when its source is unavailable"). A polled source still ages out, and so
does a source seen re-reporting even once since Home Assistant started. The
residual case is a polled source whose value has changed on every write since
start (no repeat ever seen), and it reads as on-change until its first repeat.

Thirteen older checks modelled a dead sensor with an on-change stamp
(`FakeState(last_updated=old)`) and asserted it stale. They encoded the defect.
Each now re-reports before going silent, as a polled source does:

- `_ps_state` and `_um_read` (pump mode; "polled, as the reference integration
  polls the Tuya cloud every 3 min");
- the flow-lift supply/return pair, `_sp_write`'s stale rung, `_fm_reader` and
  `_fm_plant`;
- the two `read_state` mode checks ("an over-age string ...", "staleness outranks an unrecognised value") and `_g_hstale` (humidity);
- `tests/dst_checks.py`'s mode outage.

None of them lost an assertion.

## Head

`229c6643ac04756e90813b19f2f9b7be4b154817` merges main `145bfe1` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`07b83e9b28ab3a21e3a1ad8d9b38eea27ee707e0` adds one commit to the previous head, containing only this PR's own row, `dev/programme/delivery/2683.md`. The authored code head is `5d5b807e05b50e7d80bd17a61fbba37e2153ae96`.

`a23179207dc3a417c69e1b1095128a61913ef793` merges origin/main `d05a44c63` into the authored code head `5d5b807e05b50e7d80bd17a61fbba37e2153ae96` (an automatic merge by the orchestrator's script; any resolution inside the code head is described below).

5d5b807e05b50e7d80bd17a61fbba37e2153ae96 on merge base
144fb4f900768195c64469f9647ece583a54a52b (origin/main's tip,
`git rev-parse origin/main`, 2026-10-24T01:13Z). The authored code is
7668a4d09; three merges of origin/main follow it, bf907fc5a (c5e1be196),
89ef33c7a (f046076ad) and 5d5b807e0 (144fb4f90), all automatic. Between the
first two sits 7ce0f04eb, the mutation pins (below).
`git diff --stat c5e1be196 144fb4f90 -- custom_components tests/features.py tests/mutation_ledger`
prints nothing, so every production-reading figure taken at 7ce0f04eb (merge
base c5e1be196) describes the production code at the head.

Overlap with R10-LIVESTATE (`coordinator.py`, fixer running): this diff's
`coordinator.py` hunks are the import block, `READING_SOURCES` and
`_indoor_humidity_value`. That fixer's worktree at 5496d4255, diffed against
origin/main, has none of them. Its nearest hunks start at origin/main lines
8608 and 9695, and this diff's humidity hunk at 8960. Textual overlap: none. Hunk headers read with
`git diff origin/main -- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py | grep '^@@'`
in each tree.

## Mutation proof

Run from a worktree at the head with `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/features.py`,
one mutant at a time, restored between runs (scratch driver, not in the tree):

- M1: delete the `if max_age_minutes is None: reading.max_age_minutes = age_limit_for(...)`
  wiring in `InputReader._begin` -> FAIL "all 26 age-limited keys: a quiet
  on-change source is stale only on a key named equal ...", FAIL "an on-change
  power meter idle at 0 W for 10 h reads 0 kW with no limit ...", FAIL
  "humidity: an on-change probe quiet 121 min keeps the mold floor ...".
- M2: the predicate `reported > updated` in `source_polls` -> `>=` (every
  source counts as polling: the old rule) -> the same three FAIL.
- M3: `known.add(entity_id)` -> `pass` (no source is ever remembered as polling) -> 18 FAIL, among them the census, the humidity check, "an over-age string is rejected exactly like an over-age number", "a flow reading 45 min old is stale and gives no estimate" and "a mode read minutes ago still acts, one read hours ago does not". (A first M3 that deleted the line left an empty `if` and died on an IndentationError: vacuous, discarded.)
- M4: delete the `CONF_POWER_ENTITY: math.inf` row -> FAIL "every age-limited key declares its on-change limit ...", FAIL the census, FAIL the idle power meter check.
- M0, the same driver with no mutation -> `ALL 4336 FEATURE CHECKS PASSED`, rc=0.

At the merge base a6620c30a, the first version of this PR's test (the
`tests/features.py` hunk of 61d9fdb09, applied alone) fails all four of its
checks: declaration, census, idle power meter and humidity. The census arm
names flow, energy, mode, power, return and supply as stale when quiet. The
two value checks added in 7668a4d09 call `inputs.source_polls`, which the base
does not define. M0-M4 and this base run were taken at 7668a4d09 on a6620c30a;
a6620c30a..c5e1be196 changes `away.py`, `coordinator.py` outside
`_indoor_humidity_value` and `narrative.py`, none of them `inputs.py` or
`const.py`, and the pin drive below re-measures every added site on the merged
tree.

Every mutation site the diff adds is pinned in 7ce0f04eb by
`python3 tests/mutation_table.py --pin-killed --base origin/main --scripts tests/features.py --jobs 4`
at merge base c5e1be196: `PIN KILLED: 11 pinned, 0 left unpinned`. The drive
is the kill proof per site: each mutant applied alone, `tests/features.py`
re-run, the site pinned only on red, the tree restored. Its controls, printed
by the same run: baseline `tests/features.py: rc=0 failed=0`, and the null
mutant `coordinator.py:510 NULL_COMMENT` (a comment-only edit) survived. Each
pin's `reason` in `tests/mutation_ledger/killed_by/` records its kill; the
failed counts are in `## Unpinned sites`. The drive was limited to
`tests/features.py` because the full driver set's run went `MUTATION TABLE
INCONCLUSIVE`: its `tests/entities.py` baseline (4 heartbeat checks) and
`tests/stress.py` baseline ("shoulder") are red on this Darwin seat at the
merge base too (`## Figures`), so no driver could be graded.

## Null control

The finder's harness at both ends,
`PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round10/D14/s3/staleness_on_change.py`
(in tree, sha1 6fa091e3760cf5e4e843bc763ceba27a2d4b1973):

- base c5e1be196 (a `git archive` of `custom_components` and `tests`, the
  harness copied in): `polling_stale_cycles=0`, `heat_pump_power_entity_stale_cycles=39`,
  `heat_pump_power_entity_newly_unavailable_entity_cycles=78`,
  `heat_pump_mode_entity_stale_cycles=47`, `seams=2`; its unbounded arm
  `perturb_unbounded_*_stale_cycles=0` for both.
- head 7ce0f04eb (production code identical to 89ef33c7a, `## Head`):
  `polling_stale_cycles=0`, power 0, mode 0, `seams=0`; dhw, indoor and
  outdoor 0 at both ends.

The polling day reads 0 at both ends, but its sources never die, so it cannot
show that a dead polling source still goes stale (the carry's null control).
That control is the census in `tests/features.py`. For every key of
`INPUT_MAX_AGE_MINUTES` (26 at the head, 25 at the base; the rule is
`len(INPUT_MAX_AGE_MINUTES)`), it drives the real `InputReader` and checks
three cases:

- a source that re-reported and then fell silent one minute past its polling
  limit is stale on every key;
- the same holds when the source's last write was a change, given polling
  evidence earlier on the same `hass`;
- a quiet on-change source is stale exactly on the keys `_r10st_same` names.

At the base the census fails with the six instance keys listed (above); at the
head it passes.

## Figures

- power 39, mode 47, polling 0 stale cycles at the base c5e1be196; power 0, mode 0,
  polling 0 at the head: `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round10/D14/s3/staleness_on_change.py`
  (null control: its `perturb_unbounded` arm, 0 and 0 at the base).
- Instance probe, `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round10/D14/sweep-N-staleness/probe.py <KEY>`
  (sha1 311f0e029f449ce180f569b1f515ba245daea59a), at base c5e1be196 and
  head 89ef33c7a: `CONF_POWER_ENTITY`, `CONF_HEAT_PUMP_MODE_ENTITY`,
  `CONF_ENERGY_ENTITY`, `CONF_HEAT_PUMP_SUPPLY_TEMP_ENTITY`,
  `CONF_HEAT_PUMP_RETURN_TEMP_ENTITY` and `CONF_FLOW_METER_ENTITY` rc=1
  (stale) at the base and rc=0 at the head. The controls stay rc=1 at both
  ends: `CONF_INDOOR_TEMP_ENTITY` held 361 min,
  `CONF_HEAT_PUMP_DEFROST_ENTITY` held 31 min and `CONF_WOOD_TANK_TOP_ENTITY`
  held 61 min, keys that keep their bound. The `HUMIDITY` arm reads the deleted
  `coordinator.HUMIDITY_MAX_AGE_MINUTES` and raises at the head. The humidity
  census check stands in for it: 121 min on-change keeps the floor, while
  121 min polled and 361 min on-change both drop it.
- Class enumerator (step 8), `python3 dev/audit/rounds/round10/D14/sweep-N-staleness/enumerate.py`
  (sha1 2028e7571822cdeac46e414cf8adb1226a57ea83): `RESULT seams=29 flagged=20`
  at both ends (c5e1be196, 89ef33c7a), with `--controls` `RESULT controls_ok=True` at both. It reads
  only the polling table, which this fix rightly leaves alone, so it reads flat.
  The companion that reads the defect at the base and not at the head is the
  census above. Every flagged seam is dispositioned:

  | seam | disposition |
  |---|---|
  | power | closed in this diff |
  | mode | closed in this diff |
  | energy | closed in this diff |
  | supply | closed in this diff |
  | return | closed in this diff |
  | flow | closed in this diff |
  | humidity | closed in this diff |
  | MODE_LAST_GOOD | part of the mode instance; it acts only after the mode is unreadable, still bounded |
  | the six pump signals | already guarded; named in `_r10st_same` |
  | the four wood/flue probes | already guarded; named in `_r10st_same` |
  | solar | already guarded; named in `_r10st_same` |
  | PV | no reader applies the limit, a distinct finding of class P6 |
  | DHW inlet (1440) | unflagged |
  | Open-Meteo observed (90) | unflagged, and an HTTP payload, not an entity |

  The census asserts its own precondition: the declaration check fails if a
  key is added to the polling table without an on-change decision.
- Scope: `python3 tests/closure.py select --diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) --workdir "$D"`
  printed `MODE: SCOPED -- 29 script(s) run, 4 scoped out` at 7ce0f04eb and
  again at 89ef33c7a. The run at 7ce0f04eb (Darwin arm64, Python 3.14.7):
  `GATE_SCOPE=auto GOLDEN_MODE=drift GOLDEN_REF=c5e1be196 PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub bash tests/run.sh`
  -> `5 TEST SCRIPT(S) FAILED` of 31 dispatched, the other 26 green;
  `tests/arch_score.py`, `tests/ha_contract.py`, `tests/md_tables.mjs` scoped
  out. Each of the five, and its control:
  - `tests/stress.py` and `tests/harness_headers.py`: refused by `flock-wrap`
    because the seat had not taken the gate lease (no check ran). Re-run alone
    under `tests/gate_lock.py take`: `ALL 112 HARNESS HEADER CHECKS PASSED`;
    `stress.py` `1 of 113 STRESS CHECKS FAILED`, "shoulder: cheaper than
    holding the setpoint [4.67 vs 3.96]".
  - `tests/entities.py`: `4 of 2408 ENTITY CHECKS FAILED` (2409 at
    89ef33c7a, re-run under the lease: the same 4), all in "Nightly A15
    loop-stall heartbeat (#1758)": "hb:positive_control survives one hung
    py-spy sample ...", "and a try whose sample misses the spin ...", "the
    control rests between tries ..." and "the control survives two hung
    samples ...".
  - `tests/optimality.py`: `1 of 84 OPTIMALITY CHECKS FAILED`,
    "one|summer_negative|shoulder: a recorded claim still has a gap (not
    stale) [... the claim closed and should be removed]".
  - `node tests/card.mjs`: V8 heap exhaustion, `Abort trap: 6`, with no check
    reported. Re-run at 89ef33c7a after `tests/plan_view.py` with
    `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`: `ALL CARD CHECKS PASSED`.

  The control for the first three: the same scripts at merge base c5e1be196,
  from a detached worktree on this seat under the lease. `stress.py` fails the
  same "shoulder" check at the same `[4.67 vs 3.96]` (its other 7 failures
  there are the self-comparison `GOLDEN_REF=c5e1be196` at c5e1be196 forces).
  `optimality.py` fails the same claim check, and `entities.py` the same 4. So
  none of these three is this diff's; they belong to this seat (py-spy on Darwin,
  the arm64 solver floats `fixer.md` step 15 names). CI's Linux runners grade
  them on the PR.
- `python3 tests/structure.py`: `STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED` at 7ce0f04eb and
  89ef33c7a. The authored code recorded `class_excess_loc` and
  `max_class_loc` down 8 (the humidity read), with the reason in commit
  "structure: record class_excess_loc and max_class_loc down 8 (#2234)".
- `python3 tools/pr/ci_predict.py --base origin/main`: at 89ef33c7a, "no
  closures or fast red predicted against f046076aded7" with no unpinned site.
  At 28e238127 it listed 10 (below).

## Architecture score

`python3 tools/audit/archscore/score.py --diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)`:
`Architecture score: dS +0.3221 IMPROVES`; `duplication_copies 40 -> 39 +0.3180`
(the humidity read's hand-rolled float/finite/age copy is gone);
`coord_footprint 2473 -> 2466 +0.0041` (at 7ce0f04eb on c5e1be196).

## Unpinned sites

None at the head: `prepr.sh` step 6d lists none at 89ef33c7a. The 10 sites it
listed at 28e238127 are each pinned in 7ce0f04eb by the `--pin-killed` drive
(`## Mutation proof`), killed by `tests/features.py`, baseline rc=0 failed=0.
Each failed count is the pin's own recorded `reason`:

- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py:8968 BOOLOP: pinned in this diff (`or` for `and`: rc=1 failed=1)
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py:8968 CMP_BOUND*2: pinned in this diff (`0.0 <= value`: rc=1 failed=2; "Each of the 2 sites under this anchor was killed")
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py:8968 RETURN_DEL: pinned in this diff (rc=1 failed=8)
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/inputs.py:259 GUARD_OFF: pinned in this diff (rc=1 failed=4)
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/inputs.py:285 CMP_BOUND: pinned in this diff (`>=`: rc=1 failed=5; M2 above names three of them)
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/inputs.py:287 GUARD_OFF: pinned in this diff (rc=1 failed=1)
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/inputs.py:290 GUARD_OFF: pinned in this diff (rc=1 failed=19)
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/inputs.py:292 RETURN_DEL: pinned in this diff (rc=1 failed=19)
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/inputs.py:306 RETURN_DEL: pinned in this diff (rc=1 failed=48)
- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/inputs.py:874 GUARD_OFF: pinned in this diff (rc=1 failed=4; M1 above names three of them)

## Red checks

- `mutation`, predicted by `prepr.sh` step 6d at 28e238127 (no CI check has run
  on this branch): the 10 unpinned sites above. The cheaper detector exists and
  fired: step 6d itself (`tools/pr/ci_predict.py`), whose standing cost is one
  `ci_predict.py --base origin/main` per `prepr.sh` run, already paid. It
  caught this before any push. Repaired before the handoff: pinned in
  7ce0f04eb, and step 6d lists none at the head. The refusal was the body's
  omission, not a missed detector, and `prepr.sh`'s `pr-body` arm refused it as
  it is built to.
- The local reds in `## Figures` (`tests/stress.py` "shoulder",
  `tests/optimality.py` "summer_negative|shoulder", 4 `tests/entities.py`
  heartbeat checks, the `tests/card.mjs` heap abort) are not checks of this
  branch. Each reproduces at merge base c5e1be196 on this seat (card: passes
  with a larger heap), so it is the seat's environment, not a red this diff
  turned.

Locally the first gate run at 61d9fdb09 had `tests/features.py` and `tests/entities.py` red. These were 13 checks that aged an on-change stamp as a dead sensor, plus the P2 `state_age` registry, which did not yet disposition `source_polls`. Both were repaired before the handoff (the third commit).

## Forward-carry

1. R10-HEAT-METER (next on `const.py`) adds a delivered-heat energy entity. A
   new key in `INPUT_MAX_AGE_MINUTES` now needs its on-change decision in the
   same PR. Either it overrides `INPUT_ON_CHANGE_MAX_AGE_MINUTES` (a
   total_increasing counter holds while idle: `math.inf`, like
   `CONF_ENERGY_ENTITY`), or it is named in `tests/features.py`'s `_r10st_same`
   with its reason. The declaration check refuses anything else. Control: the
   check is red at a6620c30a and green at this head. A test of a dead meter
   must re-report before going silent (`last_reported` past `last_updated`).
   An aged on-change stamp now reads as a quiet value, not a dead sensor.
   Landed in this group's `carry` (the entry starting "From R10-INPUT-STALENESS (#2683") on `handoff/audit-r10-roster` at 8d6527c07. Carry: R10-HEAT-METER
2. R10-ARCH-SHAPES (later on `inputs.py`) adds a power-kW reader there. The
   default age limit is now chosen per read by `age_limit_for` inside
   `InputReader._begin`, and a new stamp reader in `inputs.py` is refused by
   `tests/entities.py`'s P2 `state_age` registry unless it is dispositioned
   (`source_polls` is, as the re-report fact). The `_RANGE_KEYS` comment that
   group also holds is fixed here (`git grep -n ATTR_MIN_TEMP custom_components`
   returns nothing at the head). Landed in this group's `carry` (the entry starting "From R10-INPUT-STALENESS (#2683") on `handoff/audit-r10-roster` at 57bb4b33e. Carry: R10-ARCH-SHAPES

## Friction

- dev/governance/roles/fixer.md#5: unclear: the environment's `python3` on PATH lacks the
  suite's dependencies (no voluptuous); the seat venv is `/opt/hpo/venv-ci`,
  and a first harness run failed on it before `PATH` named it. Carry: dismissed: a cloud seat's environment, not a tree rule; `tools/audit/seat/cloud-setup.sh` owns PATH
- dev/governance/roles/fixer.md#5: unclear: on the Darwin seat the shims directory holds `seat-python3`, not `python3`, so `python3` on PATH stayed the system 3.11. The first `--pin-killed` drive died on a 3.12 f-string in `tests/entities.py` (`SyntaxError: f-string: expecting '}'`), and it ran again only after a `python3` symlink to the shim. Carry: dismissed: the seat's PATH recipe is the out-of-tree session block, relayed to the orchestrator in this seat's return
- dev/governance/roles/fixer.md#3: stale: the sweep's `probe.py HUMIDITY` arm reads a
  module constant this fix deletes, so it cannot run at the head; the
  in-tree census replaces it. Carry: dismissed: a round record recounts and stays as written

Fix review: blocked 07b83e9b28ab3a21e3a1ad8d9b38eea27ee707e0 carry-missing: not carried to R10-HEAT-METER or R10-ARCH-SHAPES
bus-nonce: b1e4aefc16fa189c3da536923ab6e2b4

Review round 1 of #2683 (R10-INPUT-STALENESS, class N-staleness, Closes #2234), at head `07b83e9b28ab3a21e3a1ad8d9b38eea27ee707e0`, merge base `d05a44c63`. Contract currency: `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...origin/main -- dev/governance/roles/` is empty. Detached worktrees under this seat's scratch directory, `python3.13`. Evidence files are under `evidence/`.

The fix itself measures as claimed. The only blocker is step 10.

## Blocker: forward-carry not in the tree (step 10, finding-propagation.md)

The body's `## Forward-carry` items 1 (R10-HEAT-METER) and 2 (R10-ARCH-SHAPES) are in the PR body only. `origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster` at `ea71518dcf718f7844ed03f8f488ae766eb9c36e` (re-fetched just before posting) contains none of `source_polls`, `INPUT_ON_CHANGE`, `_r10st_same` (count 0). Neither group's brief or `carry` holds the control: a new key in `INPUT_MAX_AGE_MINUTES` owes its on-change decision, the declaration check that refuses an undeclared key, and the rule that a dead-meter test must re-report before going silent. R10-HEAT-METER's existing carry ("Add the new key's max age through R10-INPUT-STALENESS's freshness rule") predates this PR and states neither.
